name: Queen Mary University of London
summary: A large east London university teaching everything from economics and law to medicine and dentistry; IB offers are often 34–36 points with HL 6,6,5–6,6,6.

ib.text: Each course sets points and three HL grades, e.g. 34 with 6,6,5 (Applied Artificial Intelligence) or 36 with 6,6,6 (Accounting and Finance, Economics); some also ask a minimum SL Maths grade.

dates.label: UCAT (Medicine): last day to sit the test
UCAS deadline for Medicine (5-year MBBS, London), 18:00 UK time
UCAS equal consideration deadline (all other courses), 18:00 UK time

notes: Without UK settled or pre-settled status you pay overseas fees for 2027 entry: £30,950 a year for Accounting and Finance, £34,750 for Applied AI, £56,650 for Medicine.
Queen Mary also teaches a five-year MBBS in Malta, applied for directly (not via UCAS) by 1 March 2027.
Medicine in London asks for a UCAT score in the fourth decile or above and an SJT band of 1–3.
